text:
Aj: quick handoff — Nebula Health trial signed yesterday (6-seat sandbox). goal: 6-week runway to pilot. private VPC preferred, SSO required. assigning owners.
Maria: thanks — can CS own the kickoff + enablement? we need clear owners for provisioning and support.
Aj: yes. Lee -> infra/provisioning. Omar -> support/onboarding call and runbook. Maria -> CS kickoff + success plan. Sachin FYI on renewal/upsell signals.
Lee: taking infra. need cloud acct id + SAML metadata. ETA 48h once I have those.
Aj: cloud id is 123456789012. SAML metadata link: https://drive.redwood.example/nebula/saml.xml. IP allowlist: 52.23.45.0/24. project tag: nebula-trial.
Omar: will schedule intro/onboarding call wk of Apr 5. please share 2-3 sample prompts and any PII examples we should mask.
Maria: capturing tasks now. quick checklist:
• Provision VPC peering + routing
• Configure SAML SSO
• Create service account + API key
• Upload sample prompt set to tests repo
• CS kickoff + expectations doc
Lee: infra checklist snippet:
```
resource "redwood_vpc_peering" "nebula" {
  project = "nebula-trial"
  peer_cidr = "10.10.0.0/16"
}
# requires cloud acct, SAML metadata, contact email
```
Aj: sending credentials & SAML metadata via secure DM to @Lee. note: customer wants logs retained 30d and KMS-managed keys.
Sachin: renewal/upsell note: trial shows high API volume expectation; flag as medium upsell opportunity to pursue in week 3 of pilot. renewal risk low but procurement timeline may be 8–10 weeks.
onboard-bot: Reminder: add the trial checklist to the account bundle and link to CS playbook. Create ticket tags: nebula, trial, vpc, saml.
Maria: next steps (owners): Lee -> create PROV ticket (PROV-4321) & share ETA; Omar -> schedule onboarding invite & prework; Aj -> share sample prompts + dev contact; Maria -> prepare kickoff doc and CS success milestones. I'll run a 15m sync once infra ticket is created. :thumbsup:
Lee: PROV-4321 created: https://redwood.atlassian.example/browse/PROV-4321. assigned to me, ETA 48h.
Aj: shared prompts to the repo and DM'd dev contact (dev@nebula.example).
Omar: invite sent for Apr 6 10am PT. prework form attached.
Maria: thanks everyone — summarizing owners in Gainsight and tagging renewal notes. if anything blocks infra or SSO, @Lee please escalate in #eng-oncall. closing thread once provisioning completes.
Aj: acknowledged.
Lee: will post completion update to this thread when done.
Maria: end of handoff — low immediate risk, owners assigned, next checkpoint after infra complete.
